title: Check whether the correspondence address matches the organisation-known address
notes: This generic process may result in multiple concrete organisation-specific processes. If important mail may go to the wrong address and no concrete deadline exists, mark the process urgent. For assistance=max, the system may handle supported address changes. For assistance=none or partial, offer user choices to update the address or keep it as-is; keeping it as-is still completes the step.

title: Voertuig overschrijven of vrijwaring regelen
notes: Use RDW OpenAPI to discover both transfer and vrijwaren operations. Offer the user a choice between overschrijven and vrijwaren when both are available. Infer legal basis such as ERFRECHT when the context supports it; do not ask for data that can be inferred. Ask only for unavailable information or choices that cannot be determined automatically. Generate the ag-ui form from discovered API request schemas and process context.
